expected_parent_change: One execution does not identify an action; it eliminates every reading of the action that contradicts it, and the survivors are a set. Measured on 7 real actions with 343 readings each in a stated grammar over a real directory: one execution settles 5 of 7 on the states the task reaches, and 2 of 7 are left with survivors that agree on every state the task reaches and DISAGREE outside it. `sort` and `sort -u` both survive a duplicate-free list; the one-shot learner that keeps the first survivor is right on the task and wrong on 5 further states across 2 actions the moment a duplicate appears. Repeating the same execution changed the verdict on 0 of 7 actions: doing it twice is the same evidence as doing it once. One action (`sort -R`) looked perfectly learnable after one execution (7 survivors) and was contradicted by the second, so the answer is REFUSE, not a memorised guess. The decision rule is three-way and computable before the second execution: act when every survivor agrees, spend one execution at the state that splits them, refuse when no reading fits. The tree's own coding measurement shows the same wall an order of magnitude larger: median 1037 surviving programs after one demonstration (max 16480), 4 of 23 tasks identified, 7 of 23 insufficient even after every example.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The ceiling is REACH, measured on real material and not argued. 2178 real fix pieces from 500 real SWE-bench Verified tasks: 75.2% are rebuilt by no operator any other task's fixes ever produced, and with every other task as experience coverage is 18.7% -- flat across experience quartiles (0.151 / 0.178 / 0.157 / 0.183), so a quarter of the corpus of experience is worth as much as none. The same wall from the other side on 100 real HumanEvalFix bugs: defect types whose edit shape the grammar can name repair at 74% (0.73 / 0.71 / 0.83), the rest at 32% (0.33 / 0.32 / 0.32) -- perfect separation, 42 points, zero anomalies, with in-grammar read from the mutation search's own source rather than asserted. So one experience per action does not solve computer use: it solves consequence knowledge, and 75.2%% of the real work needs an action with no name yet

What is the single bottleneck that, if fixed, unlocks the most capability?
Own weights from scratch, every parameter calculated, an instant knowledge source, and the best part is no part.
Hardest real tests only, never synthetic; integrity real; no self-congratulation; merge once when complete.
falsification_condition: This round is false if coverage grows with experience (the quartile test would show it), if the recomputation disagrees with the independent recording by more than the same-task operators account for, if any in-grammar defect type repairs worse than any out-of-grammar type, or if the classification survives removing the family from the grammar's source. All four are asserted in the tests

answers.the_single_bottleneck: REACH: the set of edits the proposer can name. Search, verification, memory and environment adaptation are all measured and bounded; reach is the term that sets the ceiling, and it is grown by deriving an edit from the failure witness (the test's own expected value at a localised site), never by enumerating more operator families by hand
what_is_false: that experience is the limiting term -- reach is, and experience does not move it
that competence follows from consequence knowledge: knowing what an action does is silent about which action to take when the needed action has no name in the vocabulary
that more experience per environment makes it permanent -- permamence holds only where survivors agree, and environment adaptation pays back only after the measured crossover
that the benchmark is a frontier measure -- SWE-bench Verified was retired in Feb 2026 because frontier models reproduce its gold patches from memory
what_is_true: one execution plus a computed sufficiency verdict is enough to know an action's consequence, where the survivors agree
instant learning in a new environment is real and is a cost law: adapt once, then plan
verification by execution is exact and cheap, and it is the reason anything here can be trusted
search over a fixed grammar is effective exactly on the defects inside that grammar

measured_effect.law: P(correct action) = REACH x SEARCH x VERIFICATION; experience moves REACH only by naming new actions, and it names none

recursive_obs.expected_parent_frontier_change: Five real actions, five distinct outcomes, nothing asserted: `cp payload.dat out.dat` is EXPLAINED and grows nothing (the negative control); `touch keep.dat` is INVISIBLE to the content view and is silently accepted as identity, repaired by the derived predicate `mtime_changed` because the raw timestamp field reported the action in only 5 of 6 unnormalised repeats; `sort -R payload.dat -o out.dat` is not a function of its state and is repaired by a set-valued consequence `PERMUTATION_OF_INPUT(payload.dat)`, the strongest relation every repeat satisfies, stable on a fresh execution, excluding `sort_unique` while admitting identity/copy/sort/reverse (the price, printed); `sort -u -r payload.dat -o out.dat` is outside the flat grammar (0 of 73 readings reproduce it) and is repaired by one composition `sort_unique_then_reverse`; and `mkdir newdir` is BEYOND THIS OBSERVABLE -- the effect is on disk and every one of the five views is empty, so no predicate built from the same readings can reach it and the loop refuses to grow. The frontier's claim that a system can invent the concepts it needs is therefore half true and the false half is now located: predicates, sets and compositions are derivable from within the state; a missing sensor is not, and must be requested from the interface

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Discovery costs one subprocess per (step, candidate path) and buys the difference between redoing 8 steps and redoing 14, or worse, redoing 1 wrong step and declaring the work repaired.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The rule is not about tar: any step is a function of the state it can see, so perturbing a candidate and comparing the consequence yields its read set on a GUI, a database or a network service with the matching probe.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Reading the read set off argv is wrong in both directions and fails 2 of 3 real chains; tracing requires infrastructure that does not exist here and annotates what must be discovered; asking a model is prohibited producer cognition; redoing everything works and costs 75% more, and does not tell the agent what to redo when the state is too large to rebuild.

obs_solution.white_box_harvest_note: The canonical ladder was applied in order; WHITE_BOX_HARVEST was considered and found empty. No donor model, weight or external artifact was used: the rule is a counterfactual on the tree's own action environment.

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: No synthetic case decides anything: every observation is a real subprocess on a real copy of a real state, and the refusal is produced by a real `sort -R` contradicting its own first execution.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: The unit of permanent knowledge is the survivor set, not the chosen reading: after an execution the agent keeps every transformation the observation did not rule out and decides with three cases -- act when all survivors agree on the states in reach, spend one execution at the state that splits them, refuse when none fits. Nothing is trained, and the knowledge is regenerated from the state and the grammar.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Given one real execution of an action on a real state, decide whether that execution identified the action: filter a generated grammar of state transformations, compare the survivors on the states the work can reach, and answer act / ask-once-more-at-this-state / refuse -- before spending the second execution.
